name: code-skills
description: Engineering-domain skills: code-decomposer (grade a unit of code on SPEC x EXECUTION — right + provably runs — with an execution harness and a test-vacuity linter that attacks the 'green but wrong' quadrant), regex-decomposer (grade a regex on LANGUAGE x MATCH — means the right language and won't ReDoS — with an example-set + ReDoS checker), query-decomposer (grade a SQL query on SEMANTICS x EXECUTION — right grain, actually plans — with a SQL linter and an EXPLAIN/dry-run harness), type-decomposer (grade a type/schema on MODEL x VALIDITY — make illegal states unrepresentable — with a JSON-Schema validator that runs legal/illegal instance sets, plus a model-smell linter), architecture-decomposer (grade a system architecture on STRUCTURE x INTEGRITY — right decomposition AND a dependency graph that actually holds — with an acyclicity/layering/coupling checker + the named INSIDE-OUT canon), goals-decomposer (grade a goals/charter/PRD doc on AIM x MEASURABILITY — the right ranked goals AND falsifiable, with no fluff — the OUTSIDE-IN peer to architecture-decomposer, with a charter-measurability linter; Rumelt's kernel, outcomes-over-outputs, the Goodhart probe), and figma-plugins (build, review, and test Figma plugins across the sandbox<->iframe message bridge). Skills only — self-contained.
